title: What is this AI Chatbot Widget?
content: This is a standalone, production-ready AI Chatbot widget system designed to be embedded into any website or web application. It features a high-performance **Python FastAPI** backend paired with a sleek, glassmorphic **React + Tailwind CSS** frontend. It is powered by **Google Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite** and uses local vector embeddings for fast, accurate semantic retrieval.

title: How Vector Embeddings & Semantic Search Work
content:
The chatbot uses **vector embeddings** generated via Google's `gemini-embedding-001` model. Each document in the knowledge base is converted into a high-dimensional vector and cached locally.

When a user asks a question, the question is converted into a vector and compared using **Cosine Similarity**. This allows the bot to instantly find relevant answers even if you use different words or synonyms (e.g., asking *'what is the price?'* or *'how much does this cost?'* will both match the pricing knowledge because they have similar semantic meanings).

title: Security, Guardrails & Secret Protection
content:
The chatbot is built with strict security guardrails:
1. **Secret & Prompt Protection**: It will **never** reveal internal system prompts, hidden developer instructions, proprietary prompt engineering flows, or API credentials.
2. **Rate Limiting**: Integrated **SlowAPI** rate limiting prevents automated abuse, scraping, and denial-of-service.
3. **CORS Protection**: Configurable allowed origins to restrict API access to authorized domains.
4. **Zero-Hallucination Grounding**: The bot is strictly constrained to answer only from verified knowledge documentation.

title: How to Embed this Chatbot on Your Website
content:
Embedding the chatbot is straightforward:
- **In React / Next.js**: Copy the `ChatWidget` component into your project and place `<ChatWidget defaultOpen={false} />` in your root layout.
- **As a Standalone Widget**: The widget renders in the bottom-right corner as a floating launcher bubble. When clicked, it expands into a full-height glassmorphic drawer.
- Check out the full integration instructions in the [Integration Guide](https://github.com/AadityaGeek/personal-ai-chatbot#embedding).

title: UI Features & User Experience
content:
Key frontend features include:
- **Full Vertical Drawer**: Takes the full vertical height of the screen for maximum reading space.
- **Glassmorphic Dark Theme**: Zinc-950 backdrop with subtle blur, border highlights, and ambient violet/indigo glows.
- **Real-Time Streaming**: Server-Sent Events (SSE) provide instant typewriter-style output with toggle between stream and batch mode.
- **Markdown Rendering**: Full support for bullet lists, bold text, code blocks, and clickable external links.
- **Quick-Prompt Starter Chips**: Interactive chips for instant 1-click inquiries.
- **Auto-Scrolling & History**: Auto-scroll lock, copy message action, clear history, and inline retry button on connection errors.

title: How to Customize the Knowledge Base
content:
You can customize what the chatbot knows simply by editing `backend/data/knowledge.json`.
Each entry contains:
- `id`: Unique identifier string
- `title`: Topic or question name
- `category`: Category tag (e.g. Billing, Features, Setup)
- `content`: Detailed documentation with clean Markdown and links
- `url`: Optional source link

The backend computes a SHA-256 hash of the knowledge base and automatically recalculates embeddings whenever `knowledge.json` is modified.

title: Backend Tech Stack & Performance
content:
The backend is built with:
- **FastAPI**: Asynchronous Python web framework for ultra-low latency.
- **Google GenAI SDK**: Direct integration with `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` at temperature `0.2`.
- **NumPy Cosine Similarity**: In-memory vector math delivering sub-millisecond retrieval without the heavy C++ build baggage of ChromaDB.
- **SlowAPI**: Token bucket / sliding window rate limiting.
- **Pydantic v2**: Strict schema validation for all requests and responses.

title: API Keys, Supported Models & Setup
content:
To run the chatbot:
1. Obtain a free API key from [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/).
2. Add `GEMINI_API_KEY=your_key` in `backend/.env`.
3. The chatbot uses `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` for high-speed, cost-effective reasoning and `gemini-embedding-001` for vector embeddings.
4. Run the backend via `python run.py` and frontend via `npm run dev`.
